notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.
description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Cloud of Faeries token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Cloud of Faeries token's trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
